books.title: The Three Little Pigs
books.source: FIEZEL retelling of a traditional English folk tale (public domain).

about.en: Three pigs build three houses. Only one house is strong enough.
about.id: Tiga babi membangun tiga rumah. Hanya satu rumah yang cukup kuat.

sentences.en: Once upon a time, there were three little pigs.
sentences.id: Pada suatu waktu, ada tiga babi kecil.

sentences.en: They left home to build their own houses.
sentences.id: Mereka meninggalkan rumah untuk membangun rumah sendiri.

sentences.en: The first pig was in a hurry.
sentences.id: Babi pertama sedang terburu-buru.

sentences.en: He built his house with straw.
sentences.id: Dia membangun rumahnya dengan jerami.

sentences.en: It took him only one hour.
sentences.id: Dia hanya butuh satu jam.

sentences.en: The second pig built his house with sticks.
sentences.id: Babi kedua membangun rumahnya dengan ranting.

sentences.en: It took him one day.
sentences.id: Dia butuh satu hari.

sentences.en: The third pig was slow and careful.
sentences.id: Babi ketiga lambat dan berhati-hati.

sentences.en: He built his house with bricks.
sentences.id: Dia membangun rumahnya dengan batu bata.

sentences.en: It took him many weeks.
sentences.id: Dia butuh berminggu-minggu.

sentences.en: His brothers laughed at him.
sentences.id: Saudara-saudaranya menertawakannya.

sentences.en: "Your work is too slow," they said.
sentences.id: "Kerjamu terlalu lambat," kata mereka.

sentences.en: One evening, a hungry wolf came to the village.
sentences.id: Suatu sore, seekor serigala yang lapar datang ke desa.

sentences.en: He knocked on the straw house.
sentences.id: Dia mengetuk rumah jerami.

sentences.en: "Little pig, little pig, let me come in!"
sentences.id: "Babi kecil, babi kecil, biarkan aku masuk!"

sentences.en: "No, not by the hair on my chin!"
sentences.id: "Tidak, sama sekali tidak!"

sentences.en: So the wolf blew the straw house down.
sentences.id: Maka serigala itu meniup rumah jerami sampai roboh.

sentences.en: The first pig ran to his brother's house.
sentences.id: Babi pertama lari ke rumah saudaranya.

sentences.en: The wolf followed him.
sentences.id: Serigala itu mengikutinya.

sentences.en: He blew the house of sticks down too.
sentences.id: Dia juga meniup rumah ranting sampai roboh.

sentences.en: Both pigs ran to the brick house.
sentences.id: Kedua babi lari ke rumah batu bata.

sentences.en: Their hearts were beating fast.
sentences.id: Jantung mereka berdebar kencang.

sentences.en: The wolf blew and blew at the brick house.
sentences.id: Serigala meniup dan meniup rumah batu bata itu.

sentences.en: The house did not move.
sentences.id: Rumah itu tidak bergerak.

sentences.en: He tried again, but he only became tired.
sentences.id: Dia mencoba lagi, tetapi dia hanya menjadi lelah.

sentences.en: Then he climbed onto the roof.
sentences.id: Lalu dia memanjat ke atap.

sentences.en: He wanted to come down the chimney.
sentences.id: Dia ingin turun lewat cerobong asap.

sentences.en: The third pig put a big pot of water on the fire.
sentences.id: Babi ketiga menaruh panci besar berisi air di atas api.

sentences.en: The wolf fell into the hot water and ran away.
sentences.id: Serigala jatuh ke air panas lalu lari.

sentences.en: He never came back to the village.
sentences.id: Dia tidak pernah kembali ke desa itu.

sentences.en: The three pigs lived together in the strong house.
sentences.id: Ketiga babi tinggal bersama di rumah yang kuat itu.

sentences.en: Good work takes time, but it keeps you safe.
sentences.id: Pekerjaan yang baik butuh waktu, tetapi menjagamu tetap aman.

books.title: The Ugly Duckling
books.source: FIEZEL retelling of Hans Christian Andersen's 1843 tale (public domain).

about.en: A bird grows up believing he is ugly, until he sees what he really is.
about.id: Seekor burung tumbuh dengan percaya dirinya jelek, sampai dia melihat dirinya yang sebenarnya.

sentences.en: On a quiet farm, a mother duck sat on her eggs.
sentences.id: Di sebuah peternakan yang tenang, induk bebek mengerami telurnya.

sentences.en: One egg was bigger than the others.
sentences.id: Satu telur lebih besar daripada yang lain.

sentences.en: The small eggs opened first.
sentences.id: Telur-telur kecil menetas lebih dulu.

sentences.en: Five yellow ducklings came out.
sentences.id: Lima anak bebek kuning keluar.

sentences.en: At last the big egg opened.
sentences.id: Akhirnya telur besar itu menetas.

sentences.en: A grey bird came out, and he was large and clumsy.
sentences.id: Seekor burung abu-abu keluar, dan dia besar serta canggung.

sentences.en: "He is not like us," the other ducks said.
sentences.id: "Dia tidak seperti kita," kata bebek-bebek lain.

sentences.en: They called him the ugly duckling.
sentences.id: Mereka memanggilnya anak bebek yang jelek.

sentences.en: The other animals pushed him away.
sentences.id: Hewan-hewan lain mengusirnya.

sentences.en: Even his brothers and sisters laughed at him.
sentences.id: Bahkan saudara-saudaranya menertawakannya.

sentences.en: One morning he left the farm alone.
sentences.id: Suatu pagi dia meninggalkan peternakan sendirian.

sentences.en: He walked through fields and hid in tall grass.
sentences.id: Dia berjalan melewati ladang dan bersembunyi di rumput tinggi.

sentences.en: Autumn came, and the wind grew cold.
sentences.id: Musim gugur datang, dan anginnya menjadi dingin.

sentences.en: He slept near a frozen lake.
sentences.id: Dia tidur di dekat danau yang membeku.

sentences.en: He was hungry and very lonely.
sentences.id: Dia lapar dan sangat kesepian.

sentences.en: But every morning he stood up and walked again.
sentences.id: Tetapi setiap pagi dia bangkit dan berjalan lagi.

sentences.en: Spring came, and the ice melted.
sentences.id: Musim semi datang, dan esnya mencair.

sentences.en: He saw three beautiful white birds on the water.
sentences.id: Dia melihat tiga burung putih yang indah di atas air.

sentences.en: They were swans, and he was afraid of them.
sentences.id: Mereka adalah angsa, dan dia takut kepada mereka.

sentences.en: "They will laugh at me too," he thought.
sentences.id: "Mereka pasti juga akan menertawakanku," pikirnya.

sentences.en: He looked down at the water.
sentences.id: Dia menunduk melihat air.

sentences.en: In the water he saw a white swan.
sentences.id: Di dalam air dia melihat seekor angsa putih.

sentences.en: The swan in the water was him.
sentences.id: Angsa di dalam air itu adalah dirinya.

sentences.en: He had never been an ugly duckling.
sentences.id: Dia tidak pernah menjadi anak bebek yang jelek.

sentences.en: He had only been young, and in the wrong place.
sentences.id: Dia hanya masih kecil, dan berada di tempat yang salah.

sentences.en: The three swans came near and welcomed him.
sentences.id: Ketiga angsa itu mendekat dan menyambutnya.

books.title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf
books.source: FIEZEL retelling of Aesop's fable (public domain).

about.en: A shepherd boy lies for fun, and learns what a lie costs.
about.id: Seorang anak gembala berbohong untuk bersenang-senang, dan belajar harga sebuah kebohongan.

sentences.en: A boy took care of sheep on a hill.
sentences.id: Seorang anak menjaga domba di sebuah bukit.

sentences.en: Every day was the same, and he was bored.
sentences.id: Setiap hari sama saja, dan dia bosan.

sentences.en: One afternoon he had an idea.
sentences.id: Suatu siang dia punya ide.

sentences.en: He ran down to the village and shouted.
sentences.id: Dia berlari ke desa dan berteriak.

sentences.en: "Wolf! A wolf is eating the sheep!"
sentences.id: "Serigala! Ada serigala memakan domba!"

sentences.en: The villagers left their work and ran up the hill.
sentences.id: Warga desa meninggalkan pekerjaan dan berlari ke bukit.

sentences.en: There was no wolf.
sentences.id: Tidak ada serigala.

sentences.en: The boy laughed at them.
sentences.id: Anak itu menertawakan mereka.

sentences.en: Two days later he did the same thing.
sentences.id: Dua hari kemudian dia melakukan hal yang sama.

sentences.en: "Wolf! Help me, please!" he shouted.
sentences.id: "Serigala! Tolong aku!" teriaknya.

sentences.en: The villagers ran up the hill again.
sentences.id: Warga desa berlari ke bukit lagi.

sentences.en: Again there was no wolf.
sentences.id: Lagi-lagi tidak ada serigala.

sentences.en: This time nobody laughed.
sentences.id: Kali ini tidak ada yang tertawa.

sentences.en: "Do not lie to us," an old woman said.
sentences.id: "Jangan berbohong kepada kami," kata seorang perempuan tua.

sentences.en: The boy only smiled and went back to his sheep.
sentences.id: Anak itu hanya tersenyum dan kembali ke dombanya.

sentences.en: One evening a real wolf came out of the forest.
sentences.id: Suatu sore, serigala sungguhan keluar dari hutan.

sentences.en: The sheep ran in every direction.
sentences.id: Domba-domba lari ke segala arah.

sentences.en: The boy shouted as loudly as he could.
sentences.id: Anak itu berteriak sekeras-kerasnya.

sentences.en: "Wolf! Please, this time it is true!"
sentences.id: "Serigala! Kali ini sungguhan!"

sentences.en: The villagers heard him, but nobody came.
sentences.id: Warga desa mendengarnya, tetapi tidak ada yang datang.

sentences.en: "He is lying again," they said.
sentences.id: "Dia berbohong lagi," kata mereka.

sentences.en: The boy lost many sheep that night.
sentences.id: Malam itu anak itu kehilangan banyak domba.

sentences.en: A liar is not believed, even when he tells the truth.
sentences.id: Pembohong tidak dipercaya, bahkan saat dia berkata jujur.

books.title: The Lion and the Mouse
books.source: FIEZEL retelling of Aesop's fable (public domain).

about.en: A small mouse helps a great lion, and size stops meaning much.
about.id: Seekor tikus kecil menolong singa besar, dan ukuran tidak lagi berarti banyak.

sentences.en: A lion was sleeping under a tree.
sentences.id: Seekor singa sedang tidur di bawah pohon.

sentences.en: A little mouse ran across his nose.
sentences.id: Seekor tikus kecil berlari melewati hidungnya.

sentences.en: The lion woke up and caught her.
sentences.id: Singa itu terbangun dan menangkapnya.

sentences.en: "Please let me go," the mouse said.
sentences.id: "Tolong lepaskan aku," kata tikus itu.

sentences.en: "One day I will help you."
sentences.id: "Suatu hari aku akan menolongmu."

sentences.en: The lion laughed for a long time.
sentences.id: Singa itu tertawa lama sekali.

sentences.en: "How can a mouse help a lion?" he said.
sentences.id: "Bagaimana seekor tikus bisa menolong singa?" katanya.

sentences.en: But he opened his paw and let her go.
sentences.id: Tetapi dia membuka cakarnya dan melepaskannya.

sentences.en: A week later, hunters came to the forest.
sentences.id: Seminggu kemudian, pemburu datang ke hutan.

sentences.en: They caught the lion in a strong net.
sentences.id: Mereka menangkap singa itu dengan jaring yang kuat.

sentences.en: He pulled and pulled, but he could not move.
sentences.id: Dia menarik dan menarik, tetapi tidak bisa bergerak.

sentences.en: His roar filled the whole forest.
sentences.id: Aumannya memenuhi seluruh hutan.

sentences.en: The little mouse heard him and came running.
sentences.id: Tikus kecil itu mendengarnya dan datang berlari.

sentences.en: She began to cut the ropes with her teeth.
sentences.id: Dia mulai memotong tali dengan giginya.

sentences.en: She worked all night without stopping.
sentences.id: Dia bekerja sepanjang malam tanpa berhenti.

sentences.en: In the morning the lion was free.
sentences.id: Pagi harinya singa itu bebas.

sentences.en: "You were right," he said quietly.
sentences.id: "Kamu benar," katanya pelan.

sentences.en: No kindness is ever too small.
sentences.id: Tidak ada kebaikan yang terlalu kecil.

books.title: Hansel and Gretel
books.source: FIEZEL retelling of the Brothers Grimm tale (public domain).

about.en: A brother and sister are lost in a forest, and must think their way home.
about.id: Kakak beradik tersesat di hutan, dan harus berpikir untuk bisa pulang.

sentences.en: Hansel and Gretel lived near a great forest.
sentences.id: Hansel dan Gretel tinggal di dekat hutan besar.

sentences.en: Their family was very poor that year.
sentences.id: Keluarga mereka sangat miskin tahun itu.

sentences.en: There was almost no bread in the house.
sentences.id: Hampir tidak ada roti di rumah.

sentences.en: One night Hansel heard the adults talking.
sentences.id: Suatu malam Hansel mendengar orang dewasa berbicara.

sentences.en: They planned to leave the children in the forest.
sentences.id: Mereka berencana meninggalkan anak-anak di hutan.

sentences.en: Hansel did not cry.
sentences.id: Hansel tidak menangis.

sentences.en: He went outside and filled his pockets with small white stones.
sentences.id: Dia keluar dan mengisi sakunya dengan batu putih kecil.

sentences.en: In the morning the family walked deep into the forest.
sentences.id: Pagi harinya keluarga itu berjalan jauh ke dalam hutan.

sentences.en: Hansel dropped one stone every few steps.
sentences.id: Hansel menjatuhkan satu batu setiap beberapa langkah.

sentences.en: That night the moon made the stones shine like silver.
sentences.id: Malam itu bulan membuat batu-batu itu bersinar seperti perak.

sentences.en: The children followed them all the way home.
sentences.id: Anak-anak mengikutinya sampai ke rumah.

sentences.en: The second time, Hansel had no stones.
sentences.id: Kali kedua, Hansel tidak punya batu.

sentences.en: He used pieces of bread instead.
sentences.id: Dia memakai potongan roti sebagai gantinya.

sentences.en: But the birds ate every piece.
sentences.id: Tetapi burung-burung memakan semua potongan itu.

sentences.en: Now the children were truly lost.
sentences.id: Sekarang anak-anak itu benar-benar tersesat.

sentences.en: They walked for two days.
sentences.id: Mereka berjalan selama dua hari.

sentences.en: Then they saw a small house between the trees.
sentences.id: Lalu mereka melihat rumah kecil di antara pepohonan.

sentences.en: The walls were made of bread and cake.
sentences.id: Dindingnya terbuat dari roti dan kue.

sentences.en: The windows were made of clear sugar.
sentences.id: Jendelanya terbuat dari gula bening.

sentences.en: They were so hungry that they began to eat.
sentences.id: Mereka begitu lapar sampai mulai memakannya.

sentences.en: An old woman opened the door and smiled at them.
sentences.id: Seorang perempuan tua membuka pintu dan tersenyum kepada mereka.

sentences.en: The old woman was a witch.
sentences.id: Perempuan tua itu adalah penyihir.

sentences.en: She locked Hansel in a small room.
sentences.id: Dia mengurung Hansel di kamar kecil.

sentences.en: She made Gretel work in the kitchen.
sentences.id: Dia menyuruh Gretel bekerja di dapur.

sentences.en: Every day she asked Hansel to show his finger.
sentences.id: Setiap hari dia meminta Hansel menunjukkan jarinya.

sentences.en: She wanted to know if he was fat enough.
sentences.id: Dia ingin tahu apakah Hansel sudah cukup gemuk.

sentences.en: Hansel showed her a thin bone instead.
sentences.id: Hansel malah menunjukkan tulang yang kurus.

sentences.en: The witch had weak eyes and believed him.
sentences.id: Penyihir itu rabun dan mempercayainya.

sentences.en: One morning she asked Gretel to look inside the oven.
sentences.id: Suatu pagi dia menyuruh Gretel melihat ke dalam oven.

sentences.en: Gretel understood the trick.
sentences.id: Gretel mengerti tipuan itu.

sentences.en: "I do not know how," she said. "Please show me."
sentences.id: "Aku tidak tahu caranya," katanya. "Tolong tunjukkan."

sentences.en: The witch leaned in, and Gretel closed the door.
sentences.id: Penyihir itu mencondongkan badan, dan Gretel menutup pintunya.

sentences.en: She freed her brother at once.
sentences.id: Dia langsung membebaskan kakaknya.

sentences.en: They filled their pockets with the witch's treasure.
sentences.id: Mereka mengisi saku dengan harta penyihir itu.

sentences.en: A white duck carried them across the wide river.
sentences.id: Seekor bebek putih membawa mereka menyeberangi sungai lebar.

sentences.en: Their father cried when he saw them at the door.
sentences.id: Ayah mereka menangis saat melihat mereka di depan pintu.

sentences.en: They were never hungry again.
sentences.id: Mereka tidak pernah kelaparan lagi.

books.title: The Little Prince
books.source: A simplified bilingual retelling by FIEZEL, based on The Little Prince by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry.

about.en: A stranded pilot meets a mysterious little prince whose journey across the planets reveals enduring lessons about love, friendship, responsibility, and what truly matters.
about.id: Seorang pilot yang terdampar bertemu pangeran kecil misterius. Perjalanannya melintasi berbagai planet mengungkap pelajaran abadi tentang cinta, persahabatan, tanggung jawab, dan hal-hal yang benar-benar penting.

sentences.en: The Little Prince
sentences.id: Pangeran Kecil

sentences.en: written and illustrated by Antoine de Saint Exupéry
sentences.id: ditulis dan diilustrasikan oleh Antoine de Saint Exupéry

sentences.en: translated from the French by Katherine Woods
sentences.id: diterjemahkan dari bahasa Prancis oleh Katherine Woods

sentences.en: Saint-Exupéry risked his life as an air mail pilot flying Northern Africa in the 1920s.
sentences.id: Saint-Exupéry mempertaruhkan nyawanya sebagai pilot pos udara yang terbang di Afrika Utara pada tahun 1920-an.

sentences.en: Over the past century, the thrill of flying has inspired some to perform remarkable feats of daring.
sentences.id: Sepanjang abad terakhir, sensasi terbang telah menginspirasi sebagian orang untuk melakukan berbagai aksi keberanian yang luar biasa.

sentences.en: For others, their desire to soar into the skies led to dramatic leaps in technology.
sentences.id: Bagi yang lain, hasrat untuk melayang ke angkasa mendorong lompatan besar dalam teknologi.

sentences.en: For Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, his love of aviation inspired stories, which have touched the hearts of millions around the world.
sentences.id: Bagi Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, kecintaannya pada penerbangan mengilhami kisah-kisah yang telah menyentuh hati jutaan orang di seluruh dunia.

sentences.en: Born in 1900 in Lyons, France, young Antoine was filled with a passion for adventure.
sentences.id: Lahir pada tahun 1900 di Lyon, Prancis, Antoine muda dipenuhi gairah untuk berpetualang.

sentences.en: When he failed an entrance exam for the Naval Academy, his interest in aviation took hold.
sentences.id: Ketika ia gagal dalam ujian masuk Akademi Angkatan Laut, minatnya pada penerbangan mulai tumbuh kuat.

sentences.en: He joined the French Army Air Force in 1921 where he first learned to fly a plane.
sentences.id: Ia bergabung dengan Angkatan Udara Angkatan Darat Prancis pada tahun 1921, tempat ia pertama kali belajar menerbangkan pesawat.

sentences.en: Five years later, he would leave the military in order to begin flying air mail between remote settlements in the Sahara desert.
sentences.id: Lima tahun kemudian, ia meninggalkan militer untuk mulai menerbangkan pos udara di antara permukiman-permukiman terpencil di Gurun Sahara.

sentences.en: For Saint-Exupéry, it was a grand adventure - one with dangers lurking at every corner.
sentences.id: Bagi Saint-Exupéry, itu adalah petualangan besar dengan bahaya yang mengintai di setiap sudut.

sentences.en: Flying his open cockpit biplane, Saint-Exupéry had to fight the desert's swirling sandstorms.
sentences.id: Saat menerbangkan pesawat bersayap ganda dengan kokpit terbuka, Saint-Exupéry harus menghadapi badai pasir gurun yang berpusar.

sentences.en: Worse, still, he ran the risk of being shot at by unfriendly tribesmen below.
sentences.id: Lebih buruk lagi, ia menghadapi risiko ditembaki oleh anggota suku yang tidak bersahabat dari bawah.

sentences.en: Saint-Exupéry couldn't have been more thrilled.
sentences.id: Saint-Exupéry justru sangat menikmati ketegangan itu.

sentences.en: Soaring across the Sahara inspired him to spend his nights writing about his love affair with flying.
sentences.id: Terbang melintasi Sahara menginspirasinya untuk menghabiskan malam dengan menulis tentang kecintaannya pada dunia penerbangan.

sentences.en: When World War II broke out, Saint-Exupéry rejoined the French Air Force.
sentences.id: Ketika Perang Dunia II pecah, Saint-Exupéry kembali bergabung dengan Angkatan Udara Prancis.

sentences.en: After Nazi troops overtook France in 1940, Saint-Exupéry fled to the United States.
sentences.id: Setelah pasukan Nazi menguasai Prancis pada tahun 1940, Saint-Exupéry melarikan diri ke Amerika Serikat.

sentences.en: He had hoped to join the U. S. war effort as a fighter pilot, but was dismissed because of his age.
sentences.id: Ia berharap dapat bergabung dalam upaya perang Amerika Serikat sebagai pilot tempur, tetapi ditolak karena usianya.

sentences.en: To console himself, he drew upon his experiences over the Saharan desert to write and illustrate what would become his most famous book, The Little Prince (1943).
sentences.id: Untuk menghibur dirinya, ia memanfaatkan pengalamannya di Gurun Sahara guna menulis dan mengilustrasikan karya yang kelak menjadi bukunya yang paling terkenal, Pangeran Kecil (1943).

sentences.en: Mystical and enchanting, this small book has fascinated both children and adults for decades.
sentences.id: Bersifat mistis dan memikat, buku kecil ini telah memesona anak-anak maupun orang dewasa selama puluhan tahun.

sentences.en: In the book, a pilot is stranded in the midst of the Sahara where he meets a tiny prince from another world traveling the universe in order to understand life.
sentences.id: Dalam buku ini, seorang pilot terdampar di tengah Sahara, tempat ia bertemu seorang pangeran kecil dari dunia lain yang menjelajahi alam semesta untuk memahami kehidupan.

sentences.en: In the book, the little prince discovers the true meaning of life.
sentences.id: Dalam buku ini, pangeran kecil menemukan makna kehidupan yang sesungguhnya.

sentences.en: At the end of his conversation with the Little Prince, the aviator manages to fix his plane and both he and the little prince continue on their journeys.
sentences.id: Pada akhir percakapannya dengan Pangeran Kecil, sang penerbang berhasil memperbaiki pesawatnya, lalu ia dan pangeran kecil melanjutkan perjalanan masing-masing.

sentences.en: Saint-Exupery's experiences flying would inspire his most famous book, The Little Prince.
sentences.id: Pengalaman terbang Saint-Exupéry kelak mengilhami bukunya yang paling terkenal, Pangeran Kecil.

sentences.en: Shortly after completing the book, Saint-Exupéry finally got his wish.
sentences.id: Tak lama setelah menyelesaikan buku tersebut, keinginan Saint-Exupéry akhirnya terwujud.

sentences.en: He returned to North Africa to fly a warplane for his country.
sentences.id: Ia kembali ke Afrika Utara untuk menerbangkan pesawat tempur bagi negaranya.

sentences.en: On July 31, 1944, Saint-Exupéry took off on a mission.
sentences.id: Pada 31 Juli 1944, Saint-Exupéry lepas landas untuk menjalankan sebuah misi.

sentences.en: Sadly, he was never heard from again.
sentences.id: Sayangnya, setelah itu tidak pernah ada kabar lagi darinya.

sentences.en: I ask the indulgence of the children who may read this book for dedicating it to a grown-up.

sentences.en: I knew very well that in addition to the great planets--such as the Earth, Jupiter, Mars, Venus--to which we have given names, there are also hundreds of others, some of which are so small that one has a hard time seeing them through the telescope.
sentences.id: Aku tahu betul bahwa selain planet-planet besar--seperti Bumi, Jupiter, Mars, Venus--yang telah kita beri nama, ada juga ratusan planet lain, sebagian begitu kecil sehingga sulit dilihat melalui teleskop.

sentences.en: He might call it, for example, "Asteroid 325."
sentences.id: Misalnya, ia mungkin menyebutnya "Asteroid 325."

sentences.en: I have serious reason to believe that the planet from which the little prince came is the asteroid known as B-612.
sentences.id: Aku punya alasan kuat untuk percaya bahwa planet asal pangeran kecil adalah asteroid yang dikenal sebagai B-612.

sentences.en: On making his discovery, the astronomer had presented it to the International Astronomical Congress, in a great demonstration.

sentences.en: So in 1920 the astronomer gave his demonstration all over again, dressed with impressive style and elegance.

sentences.en: And this time everybody accepted his report.
sentences.id: Dan kali ini semua orang menerima laporannya.

sentences.en: If I have told you these details about the asteroid, and made a note of its number for you, it is on account of the grown-ups and their ways.
sentences.id: Jika aku menceritakan rincian tentang asteroid ini dan mencatat nomornya untuk kalian, itu karena orang-orang dewasa dan cara mereka.

sentences.en: When you tell them that you have made a new friend, they never ask you any questions about essential matters.
sentences.id: Ketika kalian memberi tahu mereka bahwa kalian memiliki teman baru, mereka tidak pernah menanyakan hal-hal yang penting.

sentences.id: Apakah ia mengoleksi kupu-kupu?"

sentences.id: Aku ingin berkata: "Pada suatu masa, ada seorang pangeran kecil yang tinggal di sebuah planet yang hampir tidak lebih besar daripada dirinya, dan yang membutuhkan seekor domba . . ."

sentences.id: Dan jika aku melupakannya, aku mungkin menjadi seperti orang-orang dewasa yang tidak lagi tertarik pada apa pun selain angka-angka . . .

sentences.id: Untuk tujuan itulah aku kembali membeli sekotak cat dan beberapa pensil.

sentences.en: I shall certainly try to make my portraits as true to life as possible.

sentences.id: Jadi aku meraba-raba sebisaku, kadang baik, kadang buruk, dan kuharap hasilnya secara umum lumayan.

sentences.id: Dalam beberapa perincian yang lebih penting, aku juga akan membuat kesalahan.

sentences.id: Aku menjelaskan kepada pangeran kecil bahwa baobab bukanlah semak-semak kecil, melainkan pohon sebesar istana; dan bahwa sekalipun ia membawa pergi seluruh kawanan gajah, kawanan itu tidak akan mampu menghabiskan satu pohon baobab pun.

sentences.en: Indeed, as I learned, there were on the planet where the little prince lived--as on all planets--good plants and bad plants.

sentences.en: The fifth planet was very strange. It was the smallest of all. There was just enough room on it for a street lamp and a lamplighter. The little prince was not able to reach any explanation of the use of a street lamp and a lamplighter, somewhere in the heavens, on a planet which had no people, and not one house. But he said to himself, nevertheless:
sentences.id: Planet kelima sangat aneh. Planet itu yang terkecil dari semuanya. Di sana hanya ada cukup ruang untuk sebuah lampu jalan dan seorang penyala lampu. Pangeran kecil tidak dapat menemukan penjelasan apa pun mengenai kegunaan sebuah lampu jalan dan seorang penyala lampu, di suatu tempat di langit, pada planet yang tidak memiliki penduduk dan tidak memiliki satu rumah pun. Namun demikian, ia berkata dalam hati:

sentences.en: "It may well be that this man is absurd. But he is not so absurd as the king, the conceited man, the businessman, and the tippler. For at least his work has some meaning. When he lights his street lamp, it is as if he brought one more star to life, or one flower. When he puts out his lamp, he sends the flower, or the star, to sleep. That is a beautiful occupation. And since it is beautiful, it is truly useful."
sentences.id: "Mungkin saja pria ini tidak masuk akal. Tetapi ia tidak semenggelikan sang raja, pria congkak, pengusaha, dan pemabuk. Setidaknya pekerjaannya memiliki suatu makna. Ketika ia menyalakan lampu jalannya, seolah-olah ia menghidupkan satu bintang lagi, atau sekuntum bunga. Ketika ia memadamkan lampunya, ia menidurkan bunga atau bintang itu. Itu pekerjaan yang indah. Dan karena indah, pekerjaan itu benar-benar berguna."

sentences.en: When he arrived on the planet he respectfully saluted the lamplighter.
sentences.id: Ketika tiba di planet itu, ia memberi salam dengan hormat kepada penyala lampu.

sentences.en: "Good morning. Why have you just put out your lamp?"
sentences.id: "Selamat pagi. Mengapa kau baru saja memadamkan lampumu?"

sentences.en: "Those are the orders," replied the lamplighter. "Good morning."
sentences.id: "Begitulah perintahnya," jawab penyala lampu. "Selamat pagi."

sentences.en: "What are the orders?"
sentences.id: "Apa perintahnya?"

sentences.en: "The orders are that I put out my lamp. Good evening."
sentences.id: "Perintahnya adalah aku harus memadamkan lampuku. Selamat malam."

sentences.en: And he lighted his lamp again.
sentences.id: Lalu ia menyalakan lampunya lagi.

sentences.en: "But why have you just lighted it again?"
sentences.id: "Tapi mengapa kau baru saja menyalakannya lagi?"

sentences.en: "Those are the orders," replied the lamplighter.
sentences.id: "Begitulah perintahnya," jawab penyala lampu.

sentences.en: "I do not understand," said the little prince.
sentences.id: "Aku tidak mengerti," kata pangeran kecil.

sentences.en: "There is nothing to understand," said the lamplighter. "Orders are orders. Good morning."
sentences.id: "Tidak ada yang perlu dimengerti," kata penyala lampu. "Perintah adalah perintah. Selamat pagi."

sentences.en: And he put out his lamp.
sentences.id: Lalu ia memadamkan lampunya.

sentences.en: Then he mopped his forehead with a handkerchief decorated with red squares.
sentences.id: Kemudian ia menyeka dahinya dengan saputangan berhias kotak-kotak merah.

sentences.en: "I follow a terrible profession. In the old days it was reasonable. I put the lamp out in the morning, and in the evening I lighted it again. I had the rest of the day for relaxation and the rest of the night for sleep."
sentences.id: "Aku menjalani pekerjaan yang mengerikan. Dahulu pekerjaan ini masuk akal. Aku memadamkan lampu pada pagi hari, lalu menyalakannya lagi pada malam hari. Aku memiliki sisa waktu siang untuk bersantai dan sisa waktu malam untuk tidur."

sentences.en: "And the orders have been changed since that time?"
sentences.id: "Dan apakah perintahnya telah berubah sejak saat itu?"

sentences.en: "The orders have not been changed," said the lamplighter. "That is the tragedy! From year to year the planet has turned more rapidly and the orders have not been changed!"
sentences.id: "Perintahnya tidak berubah," kata penyala lampu. "Itulah tragedinya! Dari tahun ke tahun planet ini berputar semakin cepat, tetapi perintahnya tidak berubah!"

sentences.en: "Then what?" asked the little prince.
sentences.id: "Lalu bagaimana?" tanya pangeran kecil.

sentences.en: "Then--the planet now makes a complete turn every minute, and I no longer have a single second for repose. Once every minute I have to light my lamp and put it out!"
sentences.id: "Lalu--planet ini sekarang menyelesaikan satu putaran penuh setiap menit, dan aku tidak lagi memiliki satu detik pun untuk beristirahat. Setiap satu menit aku harus menyalakan dan memadamkan lampuku!"

sentences.en: "That is very funny! A day lasts only one minute, here where you live!"
sentences.id: "Lucu sekali! Satu hari hanya berlangsung satu menit di tempat tinggalmu ini!"

sentences.en: "It is not funny at all!" said the lamplighter. "While we have been talking together a month has gone by."
sentences.id: "Itu sama sekali tidak lucu!" kata penyala lampu. "Selama kita berbicara, satu bulan telah berlalu."

sentences.en: "A month?"
sentences.id: "Satu bulan?"

sentences.en: "Yes, a month. Thirty minutes. Thirty days. Good evening."
sentences.id: "Ya, satu bulan. Tiga puluh menit. Tiga puluh hari. Selamat malam."

sentences.en: And he lighted his lamp again.
sentences.id: Lalu ia menyalakan lampunya lagi.

sentences.en: As the little prince watched him, he felt that he loved this lamplighter who was so faithful to his orders. He remembered the sunsets which he himself had gone to seek, in other days, merely by pulling up his chair; and he wanted to help his friend.
sentences.id: Ketika pangeran kecil mengamatinya, ia merasa menyayangi penyala lampu yang begitu setia pada perintahnya itu. Ia teringat matahari-matahari terbenam yang dahulu sengaja dicarinya hanya dengan menarik kursinya; dan ia ingin membantu temannya.

sentences.en: "You know," he said, "I can tell you a way you can rest whenever you want to. . ."
sentences.id: "Kau tahu," katanya, "aku dapat memberitahumu suatu cara agar kau bisa beristirahat kapan pun kau mau. . ."

sentences.en: "I always want to rest," said the lamplighter.
sentences.id: "Aku selalu ingin beristirahat," kata penyala lampu.

sentences.en: For it is possible for a man to be faithful and lazy at the same time.
sentences.id: Sebab, seseorang dapat bersikap setia sekaligus malas pada waktu yang sama.

sentences.en: The little prince went on with his explanation:
sentences.id: Pangeran kecil melanjutkan penjelasannya:

sentences.en: "Your planet is so small that three strides will take you all the way around it. To be always in the sunshine, you need only walk along rather slowly. When you want to rest, you will walk--and the day will last as long as you like."
sentences.id: "Planetmu begitu kecil sehingga tiga langkah akan membawamu mengelilinginya. Agar selalu berada di bawah sinar matahari, kau hanya perlu berjalan cukup lambat. Ketika ingin beristirahat, kau terus berjalan--dan siang hari akan berlangsung selama yang kauinginkan."

sentences.en: "That doesn't do me much good," said the lamplighter. "The one thing I love in life is to sleep."
sentences.id: "Itu tidak terlalu berguna bagiku," kata penyala lampu. "Satu-satunya hal yang kucintai dalam hidup adalah tidur."

sentences.en: "Then you're unlucky," said the little prince.
sentences.id: "Kalau begitu, kau tidak beruntung," kata pangeran kecil.

sentences.en: "I am unlucky," said the lamplighter. "Good morning."
sentences.id: "Aku memang tidak beruntung," kata penyala lampu. "Selamat pagi."

sentences.en: And he put out his lamp.
sentences.id: Lalu ia memadamkan lampunya.

sentences.en: "That man," said the little prince to himself, as he continued farther on his journey, "that man would be scorned by all the others: by the king, by the conceited man, by the tippler, by the businessman. Nevertheless he is the only one of them all who does not seem to me ridiculous. Perhaps that is because he is thinking of something else besides himself."
sentences.id: "Pria itu," kata pangeran kecil dalam hati sambil melanjutkan perjalanannya lebih jauh, "pria itu akan dicemooh oleh semua yang lain: sang raja, pria congkak, pemabuk, dan pengusaha. Meskipun demikian, hanya dialah dari mereka semua yang tidak tampak menggelikan bagiku. Mungkin karena ia memikirkan sesuatu selain dirinya sendiri."

sentences.en: He breathed a sigh of regret, and said to himself, again:
sentences.id: Ia mengembuskan napas penyesalan, lalu kembali berkata dalam hati:

sentences.en: "That man is the only one of them all whom I could have made my friend. But his planet is indeed too small. There is no room on it for two people. . ."
sentences.id: "Pria itu satu-satunya dari mereka semua yang dapat kujadikan teman. Tetapi planetnya memang terlalu kecil. Di sana tidak ada ruang untuk dua orang. . ."

sentences.en: What the little prince did not dare confess was that he was sorry most of all to leave this planet, because it was blest every day with 1440 sunsets!
sentences.id: Yang tidak berani diakui pangeran kecil adalah bahwa hal yang paling membuatnya sedih meninggalkan planet ini ialah karena planet itu diberkahi dengan 1440 matahari terbenam setiap hari!

sentences.en: The sixth planet was ten times larger than the last one. It was inhabited by an old gentleman who wrote voluminous books.
sentences.id: Planet keenam sepuluh kali lebih besar daripada planet sebelumnya. Planet itu dihuni oleh seorang pria tua yang menulis buku-buku tebal.

sentences.en: "Oh, look! Here is an explorer!" he exclaimed to himself when he saw the little prince coming.
sentences.id: "Oh, lihat! Ada seorang penjelajah!" serunya dalam hati ketika melihat pangeran kecil datang.

sentences.en: The little prince sat down on the table and panted a little. He had already traveled so much and so far!
sentences.id: Pangeran kecil duduk di atas meja dan sedikit terengah-engah. Ia sudah menempuh perjalanan yang begitu jauh dan panjang!

sentences.en: "Where do you come from?" the old gentleman said to him.
sentences.id: "Dari mana asalmu?" tanya pria tua itu kepadanya.

sentences.en: "What is that big book?" said the little prince. "What are you doing?"
sentences.id: "Buku besar apa itu?" tanya pangeran kecil. "Apa yang sedang kaulakukan?"

sentences.en: "I am a geographer," said the old gentleman.
sentences.id: "Aku seorang ahli geografi," kata pria tua itu.

sentences.en: "What is a geographer?" asked the little prince.
sentences.id: "Apa itu ahli geografi?" tanya pangeran kecil.

sentences.en: "A geographer is a scholar who knows the location of all the seas, rivers, towns, mountains, and deserts."
sentences.id: "Ahli geografi adalah seorang cendekiawan yang mengetahui letak semua laut, sungai, kota, gunung, dan gurun."

sentences.en: "That is very interesting," said the little prince. "Here at last is a man who has a real profession!" And he cast a look around him at the planet of the geographer. It was the most magnificent and stately planet that he had ever seen.
sentences.id: "Itu sangat menarik," kata pangeran kecil. "Akhirnya, inilah seorang pria yang memiliki pekerjaan sungguhan!" Lalu ia memandang sekeliling planet sang ahli geografi. Itu adalah planet paling megah dan agung yang pernah dilihatnya.

sentences.en: "Your planet is very beautiful," he said. "Has it any oceans?"
sentences.id: "Planetmu sangat indah," katanya. "Apakah planet ini memiliki samudra?"

sentences.en: "I couldn't tell you," said the geographer.
sentences.id: "Aku tidak dapat memberitahumu," kata ahli geografi itu.

sentences.en: "Ah!" The little prince was disappointed. "Has it any mountains?"
sentences.id: "Ah!" Pangeran kecil merasa kecewa. "Apakah ada gunung di planet ini?"

sentences.en: "I couldn't tell you," said the geographer.
sentences.id: "Aku tidak dapat memberitahumu," kata ahli geografi itu.

sentences.en: "And towns, and rivers, and deserts?"
sentences.id: "Dan kota, sungai, serta gurun?"

sentences.en: "I couldn't tell you that, either."
sentences.id: "Aku juga tidak dapat memberitahumu tentang itu."

sentences.en: "But you are a geographer!"
sentences.id: "Tapi kau seorang ahli geografi!"

sentences.en: "Exactly," the geographer said. "But I am not an explorer. I haven't a single explorer on my planet. It is not the geographer who goes out to count the towns, the rivers, the mountains, the seas, the oceans, and the deserts. The geographer is much too important to go loafing about. He does not leave his desk. But he receives the explorers in his study. He asks them questions, and he notes down what they recall of their travels. And if the recollections of any one among them seem interesting to him, the geographer orders an inquiry into that explorer's moral character."
sentences.id: "Tepat sekali," kata ahli geografi. "Tetapi aku bukan penjelajah. Di planetku tidak ada seorang penjelajah pun. Bukan ahli geografi yang pergi untuk menghitung kota, sungai, gunung, laut, samudra, dan gurun. Ahli geografi terlalu penting untuk pergi berkeliaran. Ia tidak meninggalkan meja kerjanya. Namun, ia menerima para penjelajah di ruang kerjanya. Ia mengajukan pertanyaan kepada mereka dan mencatat apa yang mereka ingat dari perjalanan mereka. Dan jika ingatan salah seorang dari mereka tampak menarik baginya, ahli geografi memerintahkan penyelidikan terhadap watak moral penjelajah itu."

sentences.en: "Why is that?"
sentences.id: "Mengapa begitu?"

sentences.en: "Because an explorer who told lies would bring disaster on the books of the geographer. So would an explorer who drank too much."
sentences.id: "Karena penjelajah yang berbohong akan membawa bencana bagi buku-buku ahli geografi. Begitu pula penjelajah yang terlalu banyak minum."

sentences.en: "Why is that?" asked the little prince.
sentences.id: "Mengapa begitu?" tanya pangeran kecil.

sentences.en: "Because intoxicated men see double. Then the geographer would note down two mountains in a place where there was only one."
sentences.id: "Karena orang yang mabuk melihat segala sesuatu menjadi ganda. Maka ahli geografi akan mencatat dua gunung di tempat yang sebenarnya hanya memiliki satu gunung."

sentences.en: "I know some one," said the little prince, "who would make a bad explorer."
sentences.id: "Aku mengenal seseorang," kata pangeran kecil, "yang akan menjadi penjelajah buruk."

sentences.en: "That is possible. Then, when the moral character of the explorer is shown to be good, an inquiry is ordered into his discovery."
sentences.id: "Itu mungkin saja. Kemudian, ketika watak moral penjelajah telah terbukti baik, diperintahkanlah penyelidikan terhadap penemuannya."

sentences.en: "One goes to see it?"
sentences.id: "Apakah seseorang pergi untuk melihatnya?"

sentences.en: "No. That would be too complicated. But one requires the explorer to furnish proofs. For example, if the discovery in question is that of a large mountain, one requires that large stones be brought back from it."
sentences.id: "Tidak. Itu akan terlalu rumit. Tetapi penjelajah diminta memberikan bukti. Misalnya, jika penemuan yang dimaksud adalah sebuah gunung besar, ia harus membawa pulang batu-batu besar dari sana."

sentences.en: The geographer was suddenly stirred to excitement.
sentences.id: Ahli geografi itu tiba-tiba menjadi sangat bersemangat.

sentences.en: "But you--you come from far away! You are an explorer! You shall describe your planet to me!"
sentences.id: "Tapi kau--kau datang dari tempat yang jauh! Kau seorang penjelajah! Kau harus menggambarkan planetmu kepadaku!"

sentences.en: And, having opened his big register, the geographer sharpened his pencil. The recitals of explorers are put down first in pencil. One waits until the explorer has furnished proofs, before putting them down in ink.
sentences.id: Setelah membuka buku catatannya yang besar, ahli geografi itu meraut pensilnya. Kisah para penjelajah mula-mula ditulis dengan pensil. Orang menunggu hingga penjelajah memberikan bukti sebelum menuliskannya dengan tinta.

sentences.en: "Well?" said the geographer expectantly.
sentences.id: "Nah?" kata ahli geografi penuh harap.

sentences.en: "Oh, where I live," said the little prince, "it is not very interesting. It is all so small. I have three volcanoes. Two volcanoes are active and the other is extinct. But one never knows."
sentences.id: "Oh, tempat tinggalku," kata pangeran kecil, "tidak terlalu menarik. Semuanya begitu kecil. Aku memiliki tiga gunung berapi. Dua gunung berapi masih aktif dan yang satu lagi sudah padam. Tetapi kita tidak pernah tahu."

sentences.en: "One never knows," said the geographer.
sentences.id: "Kita tidak pernah tahu," kata ahli geografi.

sentences.en: "I have also a flower."
sentences.id: "Aku juga memiliki sekuntum bunga."

sentences.en: "We do not record flowers," said the geographer.
sentences.id: "Kami tidak mencatat bunga," kata ahli geografi.

sentences.en: "Why is that? The flower is the most beautiful thing on my planet!"
sentences.id: "Mengapa begitu? Bunga adalah benda terindah di planetku!"

sentences.en: "We do not record them," said the geographer, "because they are ephemeral."
sentences.id: "Kami tidak mencatatnya," kata ahli geografi, "karena bunga bersifat fana."

sentences.en: "What does that mean--'ephemeral'?"
sentences.id: "Apa arti 'fana' itu?"

sentences.en: "Geographies," said the geographer, "are the books which, of all books, are most concerned with matters of consequence. They never become old-fashioned. It is very rarely that a mountain changes its position. It is very rarely that an ocean empties itself of its waters. We write of eternal things."
sentences.id: "Buku-buku geografi," kata ahli geografi, "adalah buku yang, dari semua buku yang ada, paling memperhatikan hal-hal penting. Buku-buku itu tidak pernah ketinggalan zaman. Sangat jarang sebuah gunung berpindah tempat. Sangat jarang sebuah samudra mengosongkan seluruh airnya. Kami menulis tentang hal-hal yang abadi."

sentences.en: "But extinct volcanoes may come to life again," the little prince interrupted. "What does that mean--'ephemeral'?"
sentences.id: "Tetapi gunung berapi yang sudah padam bisa hidup kembali," sela pangeran kecil. "Apa arti 'fana' itu?"

sentences.en: "Whether volcanoes are extinct or alive, it comes to the same thing for us," said the geographer. "The thing that matters to us is the mountain. It does not change."
sentences.id: "Bagi kami, sama saja apakah gunung berapi sudah padam atau masih aktif," kata ahli geografi. "Yang penting bagi kami adalah gunungnya. Gunung itu tidak berubah."

sentences.en: "But what does that mean--'ephemeral'?" repeated the little prince, who never in his life had let go of a question, once he had asked it.
sentences.id: "Tapi apa arti 'fana' itu?" ulang pangeran kecil, yang seumur hidupnya tidak pernah melepaskan sebuah pertanyaan setelah ia mengajukannya.

sentences.en: "It means, 'which is in danger of speedy disappearance.'"
sentences.id: "Artinya, 'yang terancam segera lenyap.'"

sentences.en: "Is my flower in danger of speedy disappearance?"
sentences.id: "Apakah bungaku terancam segera lenyap?"

sentences.en: "Certainly it is."
sentences.id: "Tentu saja."

sentences.en: "My flower is ephemeral," the little prince said to himself, "and she has only four thorns to defend herself against the world. And I have left her on my planet, all alone!"
sentences.id: "Bungaku fana," kata pangeran kecil dalam hati, "dan ia hanya memiliki empat duri untuk mempertahankan diri dari dunia. Dan aku telah meninggalkannya sendirian di planetku!"

sentences.en: That was his first moment of regret. But he took courage once more.
sentences.id: Itulah saat pertama ia merasa menyesal. Namun, ia kembali memberanikan diri.

sentences.en: "What place would you advise me to visit now?" he asked.
sentences.id: "Tempat mana yang kauanjurkan untuk kukunjungi sekarang?" tanyanya.

sentences.en: "The planet Earth," replied the geographer. "It has a good reputation."
sentences.id: "Planet Bumi," jawab ahli geografi. "Planet itu memiliki reputasi yang baik."

sentences.en: And the little prince went away, thinking of his flower.
sentences.id: Lalu pangeran kecil pergi sambil memikirkan bunganya.

sentences.en: So then the seventh planet was the Earth.
sentences.id: Maka planet ketujuh adalah Bumi.

sentences.en: The Earth is not just an ordinary planet! One can count, there, 111 kings (not forgetting, to be sure, the Negro kings among them), 7000 geographers, 900,000 businessmen, 7,500,000 tipplers, 311,000,000 conceited men--that is to say, about 2,000,000,000 grown-ups.
sentences.id: Bumi bukan sekadar planet biasa! Di sana dapat dihitung ada 111 raja (tentu saja tidak melupakan raja-raja Negro di antara mereka), 7000 ahli geografi, 900.000 pengusaha, 7.500.000 pemabuk, 311.000.000 orang congkak--dengan kata lain, sekitar 2.000.000.000 orang dewasa.

sentences.en: To give you an idea of the size of the Earth, I will tell you that before the invention of electricity it was necessary to maintain, over the whole of the six continents, a veritable army of 462,511 lamplighters for the street lamps.
sentences.id: Untuk memberimu gambaran tentang ukuran Bumi, akan kuceritakan bahwa sebelum listrik ditemukan, di seluruh enam benua perlu dipelihara pasukan besar yang beranggotakan 462.511 penyala lampu untuk lampu-lampu jalan.

sentences.en: Seen from a slight distance, that would make a splendid spectacle. The movements of this army would be regulated like those of the ballet in the opera. First would come the turn of the lamplighters of New Zealand and Australia. Having set their lamps alight, these would go off to sleep. Next, the lamplighters of China and Siberia would enter for their steps in the dance, and then they too would be waved back into the wings. After that would come the turn of the lamplighters of Russia and the Indies; then those of Africa and Europe; then those of South America; then those of South America; then those of North America. And never would they make a mistake in the order of their entry upon the stage. It would be magnificent.
sentences.id: Dilihat dari jarak yang agak jauh, itu akan menjadi pemandangan yang luar biasa. Gerakan pasukan ini akan diatur seperti balet dalam pertunjukan opera. Pertama-tama tibalah giliran para penyala lampu dari Selandia Baru dan Australia. Setelah menyalakan lampu, mereka akan pergi tidur. Berikutnya, para penyala lampu dari Tiongkok dan Siberia akan masuk untuk memainkan bagian mereka dalam tarian, lalu mereka pun akan diarahkan kembali ke balik sayap panggung. Setelah itu tibalah giliran para penyala lampu dari Rusia dan Hindia; kemudian mereka yang berasal dari Afrika dan Eropa; lalu mereka yang berasal dari Amerika Selatan; lalu mereka yang berasal dari Amerika Selatan; kemudian mereka yang berasal dari Amerika Utara. Mereka tidak akan pernah membuat kesalahan dalam urutan masuk ke atas panggung. Itu akan menjadi pertunjukan yang luar biasa.

sentences.en: Only the man who was in charge of the single lamp at the North Pole, and his colleague who was responsible for the single lamp at the South Pole--only these two would live free from toil and care: they would be busy twice a year.
sentences.id: Hanya pria yang bertanggung jawab atas satu-satunya lampu di Kutub Utara dan rekannya yang bertanggung jawab atas satu-satunya lampu di Kutub Selatan--hanya mereka berdua yang akan hidup bebas dari kerja keras dan kekhawatiran: mereka akan sibuk dua kali setahun.

sentences.en: When one wishes to play the wit, he sometimes wanders a little from the truth. I have not been altogether honest in what I have told you about the lamplighters. And I realize that I run the risk of giving a false idea of our planet to those who do not know it. Men occupy a very small place upon the Earth. If the two billion inhabitants who people its surface were all to stand upright and somewhat crowded together, as they do for some big public assembly, they could easily be put into one public square twenty miles long and twenty miles wide. All humanity could be piled up on a small Pacific islet.

sentences.id: "Jika, misalnya, kau datang pukul empat sore, maka pada pukul tiga aku akan mulai merasa bahagia.

sentences.id: "Itu juga merupakan tindakan yang terlalu sering diabaikan," kata rubah.

sentences.id: Namun, dirinya sendiri lebih penting daripada kalian semua, ratusan mawar lainnya: karena dialah yang telah kusiram; karena dialah yang telah kutaruh di bawah tudung kaca; karena dialah yang telah kulindungi di balik penyekat; karena demi dialah aku telah membunuh ulat-ulat (kecuali dua atau tiga yang kami biarkan menjadi kupu-kupu); karena dialah yang telah kudengarkan ketika ia menggerutu, menyombongkan diri, atau bahkan terkadang ketika ia diam.

sentences.en: "Good morning," said the little prince.

sentences.en: And they heard the roaring thunder of a third brilliantly lighted express.

sentences.id: "Mereka menghabiskan waktu untuk sebuah boneka kain hingga boneka itu menjadi sangat penting bagi mereka; dan jika seseorang mengambilnya, mereka menangis . . ."

sentences.en: "Computations have been made by experts.

sentences.en: "But all these stars are silent."

sentences.en: "And when your sorrow is comforted (time soothes all sorrows) you will be content that you have known me."

sentences.en: "You will want to laugh with me."

sentences.en: "And your friends will be properly astonished to see you laughing as you look up at the sky!"

sentences.en: Wreck Proves To Be Saint-Exupery's P-38!

sentences.en: When French writer and aviator Antoine de Saint-Exupery flew off alone into a July night in 1944 and vanished, his mysterious end became an integral part of the story of his life.
sentences.id: Ketika penulis dan penerbang Prancis Antoine de Saint-Exupery terbang sendirian pada suatu malam bulan Juli 1944 lalu menghilang, akhir hidupnya yang misterius menjadi bagian yang tidak terpisahkan dari kisah hidupnya.

sentences.en: Now, hundreds of pieces of a wrecked Lockheed Lightning, found on the Mediterranean seabed off the coast of Provence, have been positively identified as the airplane he was flying that night on a wartime spy mission.
sentences.id: Kini, ratusan kepingan bangkai Lockheed Lightning yang ditemukan di dasar Laut Mediterania lepas pantai Provence telah dipastikan sebagai pesawat yang diterbangkannya malam itu dalam sebuah misi mata-mata masa perang.

sentences.en: French authorities confirmed the find yesterday, based on a serial number found on a piece of the tail.
sentences.id: Pihak berwenang Prancis kemarin mengonfirmasi temuan tersebut berdasarkan nomor seri yang ditemukan pada sepotong bagian ekor.

sentences.en: Saint-Exupery is beloved in France as the author of "The Little Prince."
sentences.id: Saint-Exupery dicintai di Prancis sebagai penulis "The Little Prince."

sentences.en: No body was found, and so far the wreck has not revealed any cause for the crash.

sentences.en: "This was our holy grail," Philippe Castellano, president of an association of aviation buffs who helped authorities identify the debris, told the Associated Press.

sentences.en: "We never even imagined this."

sentences.en: Castellano said some Saint-Exupery fans resisted the effort to identify the wreck, preferring to keep the mystery alive.
sentences.id: Castellano mengatakan bahwa beberapa penggemar Saint-Exupery menolak upaya untuk mengidentifikasi bangkai tersebut karena lebih memilih agar misterinya tetap hidup.

sentences.en: "In the end, I think everyone is satisfied," he said.

sentences.en: "We didn't find a body, so the myth surrounding his disappearance will live on."
sentences.id: "Kami tidak menemukan jenazah, sehingga mitos seputar kepergiannya akan tetap hidup."

sentences.en: Saint-Exupery also wrote poetic novels based on his flying adventures, such as "Wind, Sand, and Stars" and "Night Flight."
sentences.id: Saint-Exupery juga menulis novel-novel puitis berdasarkan petualangan penerbangannya, seperti "Wind, Sand, and Stars" dan "Night Flight."

sentences.en: A new opera based on "The Little Prince" opened in Houston, Texas, last year.
sentences.id: Sebuah opera baru yang diadaptasi dari "The Little Prince" dibuka di Houston, Texas, tahun lalu.

books.title: Charlotte's Web
books.author: E. B. White (1952)
books.source: FIEZEL graded retelling. The original text is still in copyright and is not included.

about.en: A spider saves a pig's life with nothing but words.
about.id: Seekor laba-laba menyelamatkan nyawa seekor babi hanya dengan kata-kata.

sentences.en: A girl named Fern sees her father carrying an axe.
sentences.id: Seorang gadis bernama Fern melihat ayahnya membawa kapak.

sentences.en: One piglet was born very small and weak.
sentences.id: Salah satu anak babi lahir sangat kecil dan lemah.

sentences.en: On the farm, a weak piglet is usually not kept.
sentences.id: Di peternakan, anak babi yang lemah biasanya tidak dipelihara.

sentences.en: Fern begs her father to let the piglet live.
sentences.id: Fern memohon kepada ayahnya agar anak babi itu dibiarkan hidup.

sentences.en: She feeds him from a bottle and calls him Wilbur.
sentences.id: Dia memberinya susu dari botol dan menamainya Wilbur.

sentences.en: Later Wilbur is sold to her uncle's farm down the road.
sentences.id: Kemudian Wilbur dijual ke peternakan pamannya di ujung jalan.

sentences.en: In the barn, Wilbur is lonely and afraid.
sentences.id: Di kandang, Wilbur kesepian dan takut.

sentences.en: One night a quiet voice says hello from above.
sentences.id: Suatu malam sebuah suara pelan menyapa dari atas.

sentences.en: It is a grey spider named Charlotte.
sentences.id: Itu adalah laba-laba abu-abu bernama Charlotte.

sentences.en: She lives in a web near the door.
sentences.id: Dia tinggal di jaring dekat pintu.

sentences.en: An old sheep tells Wilbur the truth about winter.
sentences.id: Seekor domba tua memberi tahu Wilbur kebenaran tentang musim dingin.

sentences.en: Pigs on this farm do not usually live past Christmas.
sentences.id: Babi di peternakan ini biasanya tidak hidup sampai lewat Natal.

sentences.en: Wilbur begins to cry.
sentences.id: Wilbur mulai menangis.

sentences.en: "I will save you," Charlotte says.
sentences.id: "Aku akan menyelamatkanmu," kata Charlotte.

sentences.en: The next morning there are words in Charlotte's web.
sentences.id: Pagi berikutnya ada kata-kata di jaring Charlotte.

sentences.en: The words describe Wilbur, and the farmer reads them.
sentences.id: Kata-kata itu menggambarkan Wilbur, dan petani itu membacanya.

sentences.en: People come from far away to see the pig.
sentences.id: Orang-orang datang dari jauh untuk melihat babi itu.

sentences.en: Nobody thinks of eating a famous pig.
sentences.id: Tidak ada yang berpikir memakan babi yang terkenal.

sentences.en: Charlotte writes new words again and again.
sentences.id: Charlotte menulis kata-kata baru berulang kali.

sentences.en: At the county fair, Wilbur wins a special prize.
sentences.id: Di pekan raya, Wilbur memenangkan hadiah istimewa.

sentences.en: His life is safe now.
sentences.id: Nyawanya sekarang aman.

sentences.en: Charlotte is very tired after the fair.
sentences.id: Charlotte sangat lelah setelah pekan raya.

sentences.en: Spiders do not live long, and she knows it.
sentences.id: Laba-laba tidak hidup lama, dan dia tahu itu.

sentences.en: She makes one last thing: a small sac of eggs.
sentences.id: Dia membuat satu hal terakhir: kantung kecil berisi telur.

sentences.en: Wilbur carries the sac home carefully in his mouth.
sentences.id: Wilbur membawa kantung itu pulang dengan hati-hati di mulutnya.

sentences.en: Charlotte dies alone at the empty fairground.
sentences.id: Charlotte mati sendirian di arena pekan raya yang sudah sepi.

sentences.en: In spring, hundreds of baby spiders come out.
sentences.id: Pada musim semi, ratusan bayi laba-laba keluar.

sentences.en: Most fly away, but three of them stay with Wilbur.
sentences.id: Sebagian besar terbang pergi, tetapi tiga di antaranya tinggal bersama Wilbur.

sentences.en: A true friend can change a whole life.
sentences.id: Sahabat sejati bisa mengubah seluruh hidup seseorang.

books.title: The Giving Tree
books.author: Shel Silverstein (1964)
books.source: FIEZEL graded retelling. The original text is still in copyright and is not included.

about.en: A tree gives everything to a boy, across a whole lifetime.
about.id: Sebuah pohon memberikan segalanya kepada seorang anak, sepanjang hidupnya.

sentences.en: There was a tree, and she loved a little boy.
sentences.id: Ada sebuah pohon, dan dia menyayangi seorang anak kecil.

sentences.en: Every day the boy came to play.
sentences.id: Setiap hari anak itu datang bermain.

sentences.en: He climbed her trunk and swung from her branches.
sentences.id: Dia memanjat batangnya dan berayun di dahannya.

sentences.en: He ate her apples and slept in her shade.
sentences.id: Dia memakan apelnya dan tidur di bawah naungannya.

sentences.en: The boy loved the tree very much.
sentences.id: Anak itu sangat menyayangi pohon itu.

sentences.en: And the tree was happy.
sentences.id: Dan pohon itu bahagia.

sentences.en: Time passed, and the boy grew older.
sentences.id: Waktu berlalu, dan anak itu tumbuh besar.

sentences.en: He came back one day and said he wanted money.
sentences.id: Suatu hari dia kembali dan berkata dia ingin uang.

sentences.en: The tree gave him her apples to sell.
sentences.id: Pohon itu memberikan apel-apelnya untuk dijual.

sentences.en: Years later he came back and said he wanted a house.
sentences.id: Bertahun-tahun kemudian dia kembali dan berkata dia ingin rumah.

sentences.en: The tree gave him her branches.
sentences.id: Pohon itu memberikan dahan-dahannya.

sentences.en: Later he came back and said he wanted a boat.
sentences.id: Kemudian dia kembali dan berkata dia ingin perahu.

sentences.en: The tree gave him her trunk.
sentences.id: Pohon itu memberikan batangnya.

sentences.en: Each time, the tree was happy.
sentences.id: Setiap kali, pohon itu bahagia.

sentences.en: But each time, a little less.
sentences.id: Tetapi setiap kali, sedikit berkurang.

sentences.en: Many years later, the boy came back as an old man.
sentences.id: Bertahun-tahun kemudian, anak itu kembali sebagai orang tua.

sentences.en: The tree had nothing left to give.
sentences.id: Pohon itu tidak punya apa-apa lagi untuk diberikan.

sentences.en: "I am only an old stump now," she said.
sentences.id: "Sekarang aku hanya tunggul tua," katanya.

sentences.en: "I do not need much," the old man answered.
sentences.id: "Aku tidak butuh banyak," jawab orang tua itu.

sentences.en: "I am tired. I only want a quiet place to sit."
sentences.id: "Aku lelah. Aku hanya ingin tempat tenang untuk duduk."

sentences.en: So he sat down on the old stump.
sentences.id: Maka dia duduk di atas tunggul tua itu.

sentences.en: And the tree was happy.
sentences.id: Dan pohon itu bahagia.

sentences.en: Readers still argue about this ending.
sentences.id: Pembaca masih memperdebatkan akhir cerita ini.

sentences.en: Is it love, or is it something else?
sentences.id: Apakah ini cinta, atau sesuatu yang lain?

books.title: Matilda
books.author: Roald Dahl (1988)
books.source: FIEZEL graded retelling. The original text is still in copyright and is not included.

about.en: A brilliant girl with careless parents finds her own power in books.
about.id: Seorang gadis cerdas dengan orang tua yang acuh menemukan kekuatannya di dalam buku.

sentences.en: Matilda Wormwood learns to read when she is three years old.
sentences.id: Matilda Wormwood belajar membaca saat berumur tiga tahun.

sentences.en: Her parents watch television and think books are useless.
sentences.id: Orang tuanya menonton televisi dan menganggap buku tidak berguna.

sentences.en: Her father sells old cars and cheats his customers.
sentences.id: Ayahnya menjual mobil bekas dan menipu pelanggannya.

sentences.en: Nobody in the house notices how clever she is.
sentences.id: Tidak ada di rumah itu yang menyadari betapa cerdasnya dia.

sentences.en: So Matilda walks to the library alone.
sentences.id: Maka Matilda berjalan sendiri ke perpustakaan.

sentences.en: By the age of five she has read many grown-up books.
sentences.id: Pada usia lima tahun dia sudah membaca banyak buku orang dewasa.

sentences.en: When her father is cruel, she answers with small clever tricks.
sentences.id: Saat ayahnya kejam, dia membalas dengan tipuan-tipuan kecil yang cerdik.

sentences.en: At school, Matilda meets Miss Honey.
sentences.id: Di sekolah, Matilda bertemu Miss Honey.

sentences.en: Miss Honey is gentle, and she sees the truth at once.
sentences.id: Miss Honey lembut, dan dia langsung melihat kenyataannya.

sentences.en: This child is far ahead of the whole class.
sentences.id: Anak ini jauh melampaui seluruh kelas.

sentences.en: But the head teacher is Miss Trunchbull.
sentences.id: Tetapi kepala sekolahnya adalah Miss Trunchbull.

sentences.en: She is huge, loud and frightening.
sentences.id: Dia besar, keras, dan menakutkan.

sentences.en: She punishes children for almost nothing.
sentences.id: Dia menghukum anak-anak nyaris tanpa alasan.

sentences.en: Miss Honey asks her to move Matilda to a higher class.
sentences.id: Miss Honey memintanya memindahkan Matilda ke kelas yang lebih tinggi.

sentences.en: Miss Trunchbull refuses without listening.
sentences.id: Miss Trunchbull menolak tanpa mendengarkan.

sentences.en: One day, in a moment of anger, something strange happens.
sentences.id: Suatu hari, dalam kemarahan, sesuatu yang aneh terjadi.

sentences.en: Matilda moves a glass of water without touching it.
sentences.id: Matilda menggerakkan gelas air tanpa menyentuhnya.

sentences.en: She practises secretly until she can control it.
sentences.id: Dia berlatih diam-diam sampai bisa mengendalikannya.

sentences.en: Miss Honey tells Matilda about her own childhood.
sentences.id: Miss Honey menceritakan masa kecilnya sendiri kepada Matilda.

sentences.en: Her aunt took her house and her money, and that aunt is Miss Trunchbull.
sentences.id: Bibinya mengambil rumah dan uangnya, dan bibi itu adalah Miss Trunchbull.

sentences.en: Matilda decides to use her power for her teacher.
sentences.id: Matilda memutuskan memakai kekuatannya untuk gurunya.

sentences.en: In class, a piece of chalk begins to write by itself.
sentences.id: Di kelas, sebatang kapur mulai menulis sendiri.

sentences.en: It writes a message in the voice of Miss Honey's dead father.
sentences.id: Kapur itu menulis pesan dengan suara ayah Miss Honey yang telah meninggal.

sentences.en: It tells Miss Trunchbull to give everything back.
sentences.id: Pesan itu menyuruh Miss Trunchbull mengembalikan semuanya.

sentences.en: Miss Trunchbull is terrified and leaves for good.
sentences.id: Miss Trunchbull ketakutan dan pergi untuk selamanya.

sentences.en: Miss Honey gets her house and her life back.
sentences.id: Miss Honey mendapatkan kembali rumah dan hidupnya.

sentences.en: Matilda's parents must suddenly leave the country.
sentences.id: Orang tua Matilda tiba-tiba harus meninggalkan negara itu.

sentences.en: Matilda asks to stay with Miss Honey instead.
sentences.id: Matilda meminta untuk tinggal bersama Miss Honey.

sentences.en: Her parents agree without arguing, and drive away.
sentences.id: Orang tuanya setuju tanpa berdebat, lalu pergi.

sentences.en: For the first time, Matilda lives with someone who sees her.
sentences.id: Untuk pertama kalinya, Matilda tinggal bersama orang yang benar-benar melihatnya.
